question: Who among the following is head of government?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e__** Prime Minister of India,**__

 
• **Prime Minister of India **is the head of government.
 
• The Prime Minister of India is the leader of the **executive** of the Government of India.
 
• The **President of India is the head of state.**
